# CycloneDX 1.6 schemas

Unmodified copies of the official CycloneDX 1.6 JSON schemas, from
[CycloneDX/specification](https://github.com/CycloneDX/specification/tree/1.6/schema), which is licensed under
Apache-2.0 (see [LICENSE](LICENSE)). `tests/test_ai_inventory.py` validates generated BOMs against them when `jsonschema` is installed.
